notes.title: ANIMAENGINE 5.0.0
notes.content: Improved animation engine for new animations that support the g4 format created by us. Don't worry, any animation created with Anima will have that format. We added an option to resize animations with just a button in the animations menu, and three new tools in the creators menu. You will no longer have to restart the application to see your animations downloaded from the workshop.

notes.title: Second screen update
notes.content: Now you can drag your animation and place it on secondary monitors

notes.title: emergency update
notes.content:
I'm working on all your comments. Thanks for all your feedback. This update resolves the crash issue with the AI ​​tool for removing backgrounds. A "tutorial" section is included in the main menu for new users. Cache options have been added to the configuration section so animations load faster when they have many or very large animations, as well as options for clearing static memory.

PENDING: The code is already updated to be able to move animations to secondary monitors without having to press the button. BUT it hasn't been tested yet since I'm away and don't have a testing area. I'll run the relevant tests in two days, so please be patient.

PENDING:
The code for adding more than one animation is already being tested and optimized to provide the best user experience. I still need to run quality tests, so if all goes well, the update will be uploaded tomorrow.

notes.title: INTERFACE UPDATE!!!!!!!!!!!!
notes.content:
First of all, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, dear users. I have resolved the interface issues, and now there are three ways to run AnimaEngine:

AnimaENGINE – Designed for PCs with a low refresh rate, typically older or unofficial versions of Windows 10. 😆
AnimaEngineTK – Optimized for faster refresh rate interfaces, usually for newer Windows 10 and Windows 11.
AnimaEngineKIVI – Combines the best of both worlds, supporting both environments.
As with everything in life, it's best for users to test all three interfaces and choose the one that feels best for them.

Remember, if you have any questions, you can always reach out to us via Discord, email, or social media.

Thank you in advance, and have a great start to your week! 🚀

notes.title: BIG UPDATE 4.0.0
notes.content:
Dear users,  

Thanks to the support team’s help, we have successfully resolved the issues that arose during the week. I’m happy to inform you that, in addition to fixing those problems, I’ve updated the interface to a more modern and personally easier-to-understand design.  

We still need to update elements of the store page since the interface has changed. As for the language packs, we’ll have them ready this week. We’ll also be creating more tutorials, which will be uploaded to Discord and YouTube (I already let go of the one who wasn’t making the tutorials XD).  

Anyway, we truly appreciate your patience. Sending you all a big hug, and I hope you enjoy the software!

notes.title: emergency update
notes.content: As we do not want our users to feel insecure, we have decided to eliminate Gestor.exe due to the false positives, now the user will have to restart manually Closing and opening AnimaEngine but that will stop it being detected as a virus, this will only have to be done by new users in the configuration stage

notes.title: UPDATE 3.0.7

notes.title: Update 3.0.4
notes.content:
We solved a problem that caused Windows to detect Gestor.exe as a virus, due to the compiler we used to create that executable, that executable only opens and closes AnimaEngine so you can be sure that it is nothing bad, we attach the Gestor.exe code:

subprocess.Popen("taskkill /im AnimaEngine.exe /F", shell=True)
time.sleep(1)
subprocess.Popen("AnimaEngine.exe")

As you can see, it only opens and closes the app when it needs to be restarted.
